from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper in the collection with its outgoing reference links."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
